field_semantics.title: Legacy human-readable display label; may include author shorthand and must not be treated as exact bibliographic identity.
field_semantics.display_label: Explicit UI/display label, identical to the legacy title unless curated otherwise.
field_semantics.canonical_title: Exact bibliographic title only when independently resolved; DOI/PMID remain primary identity fields.
field_semantics.edge_source_role: In HBBA_EDGE_AUDIT source_records, supports_relation=context is contextual/limitation literature and MUST NOT be counted as direct or partial relation support.
field_semantics.study_design: Normalized publication/study class. Allowed current values: meta_analysis, systematic_review, review, experiment, experimental_series, longitudinal, cross_sectional, observational, methods, guideline, other. systematic_review is reserved for publications with explicit systematic-review methodology.
